policy: Report each source, genre and input condition separately. Essays and conversations are both useful. Do not treat one as a proxy for the other or pool them into an unqualified accuracy score.

corpora.selection: Freeze a no-tuning frequency-share estimator before the 405-query MOE screen; surviving variant uses all 31527 broad, 4608 chat and 6144 English conditions. Freeze 28 diagnostic Google queries before new observations, including all four adverse Space cases and hash-selected strata.
corpora.leakage: Only retained production phrase counts enter estimation; external readings, corpus targets and phone outputs are scored afterward. Prior corpus exposure is explicit; new provider observations are a diagnostic, not a population holdout.
corpora.limitations: Lexical phrase frequency is not spoken reading frequency. Incomplete spelling completions can be valid even without full-reading reference support. Native merge and 28 packaged phone cases now verified; timing, human touch and release gates remain separate. Raw corpora, joins and phone captures are not published.

corpora.selection: All supplied concise single-Han Pinyin readings: 405 spellings, 6402 reference pairs. All three pinned source priority tiers. Original official archives and raw joins stay local; aggregate receipts pin them.
corpora.leakage: Independent editorial readings are joined after decoding only. Previously inspected source and overlapping prior inputs are not a fresh holdout. No reference text or label enters estimator/runtime.
corpora.limitations: Learner references are not conversation frequency. Missing complete readings can be valid completions; no semantic-invalidity claim. CC BY-ND source is reference-only, not a derivative production-data approval.

corpora.selection: 720 existing queries; 16 SHA256-selected distinct readings per mode/source/condition. Inputs frozen before timing, no target availability or ranking consulted. Four mode-specific shards preserve every stratum.
corpora.leakage: Reused evaluated corpora. Original source role and document identities retained; no fresh holdout or production vocabulary use.
corpora.limitations: ASCII letters only, 1-32 keys; source conditions independently sampled. Authored Taiwanese examples are not spontaneous conversation. OS injected events and frame callback delivery do not measure physical touch or panel presentation. Single-query reset editor only; inventory does not certify the full release gate.

corpora.selection: All eligible following-token positions after within-utterance sentence resets; complete official Taskmaster dev/test and all GUM conversation/essay documents in the existing train/dev cache. Decontaminated official Taskmaster training only contributes to the pilot.
corpora.leakage: First-use Taskmaster prediction evaluation has now been consumed; reused GUM documents are not a fresh holdout. Whole-dialogue train duplicates and train/evaluation overlaps excluded before counts.
corpora.limitations: Taskmaster shared domains and instructions remain. Single-reference next-word recall is not semantic precision, whole typing coverage or phone latency. Pilot is rejected as a sole replacement; production remains unchanged.

corpora.selection: 512 salted-hash eligible lines from one pinned evaluation-only donated chat file, complete excerpt and two hash-selected short spans per line, full/initial/mixed spelling. Frozen before candidate queries.
corpora.leakage: Text source is evaluation only. Reading annotation shares production McBopomofo lineage, with ambiguity exclusions. No target labels enter ranking. The entire source document is reserved for evaluation; no training split is made from shuffled lines.
corpora.limitations: Upstream excerpts are edited, de-identified, split and shuffled; source conversation/speaker identities unavailable. Most source lines have ambiguous/unavailable readings. Not natural multi-turn accuracy or a fresh conversation holdout. Existing essay/encyclopedic/English probes are reused regression sources, reported separately. Trial rejected and withdrawn.

corpora.selection: All upstream Pinyin tags plus independently source-supported readings, frozen before the compiler change. Full, initials, alternating full/initial, reverse alternating, and separated conditions.
corpora.leakage: Known-source retrieval contracts intentionally overlap production source inventory. Expected readings derive from existing licensed word readings or unambiguous units, not the new segmentation helper. Production uses only source tags, Han count and the existing syllable inventory; no target labels or corpus-based score fitting.
corpora.limitations: Not linguistic accuracy, an independent pronunciation oracle, or a fresh holdout. Broader Chinese and English tests reuse the already registered Chinese-recovery and conversation-ranking corpora; report genres separately. Compact-tag ambiguity and bounded-result collisions remain. Desktop pack timing is not Android touch latency.

corpora.selection: 800 existing boundary cases plus every dictionary-covered substring up to six Han characters after a nonempty prefix in eight existing authored scenarios and 64 hash-selected Taiwan.md documents; full, initial and mixed readings frozen before results.
corpora.leakage: Model counts remain frozen. Target text generates reading conditions and scores output only; runtime receives context and typed reading, never expected output. No corpus text enters production assets.
corpora.limitations: Conditional dictionary-covered substring ranking, not free-running conversations. Source readings are not an independent pronunciation oracle. Authored conversation data contains only eight existing scenarios. All underlying text was previously evaluated, so this is not a fresh holdout. Rejected estimator is archived, not shipped.

corpora.selection: Same pinned corpus, vocabulary, profiles and matched seeds as the earlier pilot. Freeze gap removal, 9/8/9 reflow and aligned-versus-staggered packing before evaluation. Reproduce QWERTY and split KALQ; reuse pinned Colemak and Dvorak results.
corpora.leakage: No layout optimization or dictionary weighting against evaluation text. Expected words only generate intended contacts and score results. No production data or behavior changes.
corpora.limitations: Synthetic nearest-center geometry and already consumed corpus. Control-boundary audit is separate from the word decoder and does not establish end-to-end segmentation accuracy. Reflow is not published KALQ; staggered cells are not regular hexagons. No human speed, learning, latency or fresh holdout claim.

corpora.selection: Same complete eligible token stream, dictionary, noise profiles and seeds as the frozen layout pilot. Two KALQ adaptations preserve published block letter/space-hole positions with rectangular cells, at 30 and 40 mm height; QWERTY rerun unchanged.
corpora.leakage: No changes to original decoder, priors or production vocabulary. Published KALQ geometry is not optimized against the corpus. Reference words score outcomes only.
corpora.limitations: Letter-only assumed-noise screen, not complete KALQ behavior. Internal space activations are excluded despite preserved space holes. Extra-height variant is not equal-height. Corpus already consumed; no human accuracy, WPM or latency claim.

corpora.selection: All existing GUM TSV tokens matching lowercase ASCII letters, length 1-20; entire apostrophe tokens excluded and counted. All layouts, widths, profiles and seeds frozen before results. No production import.
corpora.leakage: Decoder sees tap coordinates, geometry, observed length and production lexicon only. Expected text scores outcomes. GUM does not supply word priors, layout weights or thresholds.
corpora.limitations: Synthetic contact distributions, letter-only adapted layouts, oracle word boundaries. No measured human accuracy, WPM, Android latency or fresh holdout.

corpora.selection: Replay every prior null construction query under both add-on settings. Compare visible-default, single-entry lookup and whole-input ordering independently. Reuse all 18 fixed-delay Google/MinIME phone cases without reselection.
corpora.leakage: Consumed regression; original references and queries unchanged. Labels are scoring inputs only. No production vocabulary or source-weight changes. Google remains an observed comparator, not training data.
corpora.limitations: Reference reconstruction is not semantic precision. No fresh Mandarin conversation holdout. Phone comparison is a small frozen sample. Injected event/frame callbacks do not measure physical touch or display presentation, and missing frames remain unobserved.

corpora.selection: All 11220 existing construction queries; GUM conversation/essay rows retained verbatim. Hash-selected 64 queries per role/condition for ideal-user incremental entry, 32 per development condition for repeated timing, and 18 reference phone cases. Original and fixed-delay phone runs use every same case.
corpora.leakage: Previously consumed reference material. Targets enter scoring and an explicitly reference-guided ideal-user selector, never candidate generation or ranking. No production entries, source weights or default changes. Google output is a comparator, not a training source or expected label.
corpora.limitations: No natural Mandarin conversation corpus, independent semantic precision grading, real human correction/time measurement, or phone testing of the experimental null decoder. Greedy reference-guided selection is not an optimal-path guarantee. Static native controls differ from the upstream DLL on two reserved queries; within-experiment native builds share the same toolchain and dependencies.

corpora.selection: Frozen SHA-256 document/span order: 40 previously audited development documents and 48 disjoint validation documents, selected before native decoding. Up to 32 Han spans per document; 3–16 glyphs; unique original McBopomofo readings. 11220 full/partial/initial/mixed inputs. Validation documents were unseen before the policy freeze, and are consumed regression evidence now.
corpora.leakage: Han reference comes from source prose, not decoder output. Runtime sees raw input, fixed dictionaries and native origin only. Reading annotation shares McBopomofo lexical lineage with production; no reference labels or phrase-specific promotions enter ranking. No production data refresh.
corpora.limitations: Exact reconstruction is not a human semantic judgement. Taiwan.md editorial provenance varies and can include AI assistance. Ambiguous/unmapped readings and long spans are excluded. No natural Taiwan Mandarin conversation coverage. Core replay excludes live native/UI latency; desktop native timing excludes physical touch.

corpora.selection: All 64 clauses from the existing 1311-key phone stream, retaining source order and final raw input per clause; no selection by timing or matching output.
corpora.leakage: Consumed development stream. Runtime sees typed input and fixed dictionaries only. No reference promotion, vocabulary changes, or new accuracy claim.
corpora.limitations: Desktop dispatch uses a deferred worker stand-in; Android comparisons exercise real AsyncDecoder and the test-only native provider. Neither measures physical touch-to-display latency.

corpora.selection: SHA-256 order, up to 256 rows per existing source group/input condition, plus all 1311 prior phone typing keys. Phone Java lookup uses every sixteenth frozen row. No selection by measured latency or candidate quality.
corpora.leakage: Consumed regression and source-retrieval evidence only. Production-overlapping source probes do not measure independent coverage. Runtime sees raw input and enabled pack only; no reference labels or target promotion.
corpora.limitations: Direct Java lookup excludes base English lookup and full sentence decoding. Chinese add-on essay results are not overall Chinese IME coverage. No fresh holdout or physical touch latency claim. Existing source attribution remains applicable.

corpora.selection: Eight hash-selected articles per topical folder at pinned commit; 104 topical samples. sample-records also contains About/resources and Kemdict evidence, which the source/category selector must exclude.
corpora.leakage: Already inspected for source quality. Not an unseen holdout. No production extraction from these artifacts. Before ranking evaluation, measure overlap with production sources by document and normalized passage; copied/rephrased Wikipedia content requires lineage review.
corpora.limitations: Audit-ready prose, not yet annotated IME targets. Useful for terminology, names, longer phrasing and punctuation. Human review status varies. Do not infer conversational frequency, generate gold readings from the decoder under test, or call filename membership typing accuracy.

corpora.selection: Reuse the pinned GUM test export and existing per-row genre labels; 1,285 rows. Retain its source manifest rather than re-extracting a favorable sample.
corpora.leakage: Previously evaluated during vocabulary changes; suitable for regression, not fresh generalization claims. No GUM data enters context training. Recheck text overlap if future production sources change.
corpora.limitations: English only. The 193 conversation rows and 60 essay rows are separate denominators. A typed reconstruction of spoken dialogue is not recorded touchscreen behavior. Source rights remain governed by the original corpus notices.

corpora.selection: Existing 13,014-row core corpus; preserve en-dev/en-test, zh-dev/zh-test and moe-glyph labels from its detailed manifest.
corpora.leakage: Context training uses separate upstream train splits, but these development/test rows have already informed regression work. Do not market them as unseen. Shared upstream source lineage also limits independence.
corpora.limitations: The historical folder name conversation-ranking does not make Chinese Wikipedia-derived spans natural conversation. Glyph reference probes and derived phonetic queries are not sentence-level accuracy. No Taiwan conversational representativeness is established.

corpora.selection: Hash-selected 16 queries per existing corpus/pack/input-mode group, with full, half and first-letter variants (1488 queries). Native acceptance uses 32 hash-selected rows per legacy group (352). Phone uses the first selected triple in each group (93 queries). Seeds and original source digests are in corpus.json and tools/make_latency_corpus.py.
corpora.leakage: Reuses inspected regression sources and source-derived dictionary queries. Suitable for timing and exact output parity only; not a fresh language-quality holdout. No production entries, source decisions or ranking weights changed.
corpora.limitations: Hash sampling is per source/mode, not traffic weighted. No natural conversation or essay representativeness claim; broad existing source groups remain separate. Callback timing excludes touch dispatch, final layout and display refresh. Synthetic prefix variants are not observed human typing errors.

corpora.selection: Frozen hash selection by complete source document, then occurrences: eight GUM conversation documents, four GUM essays, two previously audited Taiwan.md essays per category, and 128 everyday entries per third-language pack. 3922 complete, partial and deterministic transposition queries. See coverage-manifest.json and make_mode_corpus.py.
corpora.leakage: GUM train/dev exports are not MinIME training data: they were newly acquired and frozen after mode design, before candidate outputs, for a first-use holdout. Now evaluated and not fresh for future changes. Taiwan.md was already audited and has possible Wikipedia lineage. Chinese reading resolution uses original McBopomofo annotations shared with the production lexicon, not decoder output; this limits independence. Dictionary probes are explicitly seen-source retrieval.
corpora.limitations: No accessible, permission-cleared Taiwan Mandarin conversation sample or independent Japanese/Taiwanese conversation/essay corpus was acquired. Chinese prose excludes unresolved or ambiguous reference readings and outside-window spans; counts are explicit. GUM input uses source-prefix words as accepted context. Coverage uses fully visible whole-input candidates and measured Android font/viewport sizes, not fixed top-N rank; timing uses a separate uncached phone test.

corpora.selection: All 504 numbered headwords from pinned MOE beginner handout; complete inventory frozen before sidecar change.
corpora.leakage: Previously unseen handout now inspected for extraction. It shares editorial lineage with Taiwan dictionaries; no independent language-accuracy or spelling-consensus claim. No handout data enters production.
corpora.limitations: Printed romanization has damaged PDF extraction and is not gold. Han inventory tests spelling presence, not sense or dialect correctness; duplicate spellings are retained by numbered item.

corpora.selection: Every shipped authored beginner headword/variant, shortest tone-free source alias, complete/prefix/initial input. Frozen 15,489 queries for 5,163 outputs.
corpora.leakage: Targets and keys are from the existing production source; this verifies retrieval and paired metadata, not language accuracy or new independent holdout coverage.
corpora.limitations: Does not measure sense correctness, spontaneous conversation, dialect coverage or spelling consensus. Rank is within the bounded optional dictionary results, not pixel visibility.

corpora.selection: All eligible source-common kana readings, plus a fixed hash-selected 1,024-reading partial/initial sample; frozen before generation outcomes.
corpora.leakage: Targets and aliases are production-source records. No independent conversation, essay, accuracy or fresh-holdout claim.
corpora.limitations: Source commonness is imperfect. Does not measure sentence conversion, sense correctness, modern usage or spontaneous human typing.

corpora.selection: All supported source headwords and aligned variants, full tone-free queries plus 2048 deterministic hash-selected half-reading probes. Frozen before importer expansion. Reproduced by tools/audit_focused_dictionaries.py.
corpora.leakage: Production-source targets measure source retrieval only; not independent conversation or essay accuracy.
corpora.limitations: No lexical frequency, sense, spontaneous conversation, spelling consensus or grammar evaluation. Query variants remain grouped by source ID.

corpora.selection: All 1555 recovered spellings under complete tone-free input, plus SHA256(query) first 8 hex digits modulo 128 controls. Half-reading probes use fixed modulo 8 selection. Full source union inventory is exhaustive; runtime probes are bounded and frozen before ranks.
corpora.leakage: Targets and aliases share production sources. Not independent language accuracy or a fresh holdout.
corpora.limitations: Commonness, dialect coverage, modern conversation and intended sense are not measured. Five formerly reachable partial targets are displaced by recovered entries.

corpora.selection: All 546 distinct shipped POJ ASCII outputs equal to a normalized reading, plus 546 marked reading/output controls selected by SHA256 order before observing results. Frozen during the preceding diagnostic on ab296aa.
corpora.leakage: Production-source retrieval probes; not independent language accuracy, commonness or a fresh holdout.
corpora.limitations: Does not measure source omissions, usage frequencies, spontaneous conversation, essay quality, partial-input coverage, or physical touch latency.

corpora.selection: Frozen source-conversation/file SHA256 splits; source-bound word/two-token/clause sampling and deterministic error conditions. Separate originally fresh holdout partition in references. No production queries used for reference selection.
corpora.leakage: Japanese conversations and modern Taiwanese source files disjoint between development and initial holdout, with recurring speakers/phrases explicitly allowed. Historical beginner material shares production lineage. No new corpus text is used as production vocabulary or training.
corpora.limitations: Japanese Kanji reading annotations are silver. Modern Taiwanese examples are authored situations rather than spontaneous multi-turn dialogue. No physical touch observations or human community-usage labels.

corpora.selection: Frozen before provider queries: 128 new source dialogues, eight hash-selected turns each, document-disjoint development/initial holdout. All 200 external AJIMEE items. After this run all partitions are consumed evaluation data.
corpora.leakage: Exclude prior conversation files; flag repeated texts and cross-role repeats. No evaluation text enters production. Public AJIMEE may have upstream-author exposure; no speaker-disjoint claim.
corpora.limitations: Oracle user selection and Sudachi word boundaries. Silver conversation readings, simulated romanization/errors, explicit unreadable failures. Desktop timing excludes physical touch/rendering.

corpora.selection: SHA256 predictive-v1 order; 32 valid clauses and 32 words per source from prior development conversations, 2-24 raw keys, full/half/three-quarter conditions. Stop slow candidates using frozen deadlines.
corpora.leakage: Consumed development references; no new holdout claim. Prior holdouts reused only as explicit behavior-parity regression. No production use.
corpora.limitations: Early rejection prevents population coverage estimates for predictive modes. Synthetic trie validates mechanism only. No phone latency measured.

corpora.selection: Exact replay of the previously frozen 64-clause/1311-key development timing stream. Preserve initial desktop references and phone results; stable beam follow-up changes only expected converter output, not inputs.
corpora.leakage: Consumed regression evidence; labels are not runtime inputs. No production corpus use or fresh holdout claim.
corpora.limitations: Simulated romanization prefixes and burst typing; native query/worker delivery are not physical touch or display latency. No language accuracy estimate.
